_source: rsprox 233/00449-00461 (the varbits, the order of a lap's end, Tag, Pay, Redeem and their lines) and the Wiki (Agility dispenser, Wilderness Agility Course, Wilderness agility ticket: the loot tables, the ticket XP, the streak rules).
_lapStart: The course's first obstacle: starting it with an unclaimed ticket or reward resets the streak (Wiki).
_course: The course pit, from the pipe to the climbing rocks; leaving it loses the payment (recorded after the exit ridge).
_logoutStreakLoss: Wiki: logging out takes 10 laps off the streak (recorded: 5 -> 0, 1 -> 0).
_redeem: Wiki: XP per ticket by how many are redeemed at once (recorded 200 each for 1, 2 and 3).
_tiers: Wiki: from this many laps in the reward streak. Resources are noted, rolled once; armour is noted, rolled once.
_extra: Wiki: with a free inventory slot, one unnoted blighted food (5/16 each) or super restore(4) (1/16) as well (recorded: anglerfish, karambwan, super restore).
